meta.title: Radios
meta.lead: The native `<input type="radio">` with a custom and responsive style.

blocks.label: Radios example
blocks.demo: <article aria-label="Radios example" class="component"><fieldset><legend>Language preference:</legend><label><input checked="" name="language" type="radio"/>English</label><label><input name="language" type="radio"/>French</label><label><input name="language" type="radio"/>Mandarin</label><label><input name="language" type="radio"/>Thai</label><label aria-disabled="true"><input disabled="" name="language" type="radio"/>Dothraki</label></fieldset></article>
blocks.code:
<fieldset>
  <legend>Language preference:</legend>
  <label>
    <input type="radio" name="language" checked />
    English
  </label>
  <label>
    <input type="radio" name="language" />
    French
  </label>
  <label>
    <input type="radio" name="language" />
    Mandarin
  </label>
  <label>
    <input type="radio" name="language" />
    Thai
  </label>
  <label aria-disabled="true">
    <input type="radio" name="language" disabled />
    Dothraki
  </label>
</fieldset>

blocks.label: Horizontal stacking example
blocks.demo: <article aria-label="Horizontal stacking example" class="component"><fieldset><legend>Second language:</legend><input checked="" id="hindi" name="second-language" type="radio"/><label for="hindi">Hindi</label><input id="swahili" name="second-language" type="radio"/><label for="swahili">Swahili</label><input disabled="" id="navi" name="second-language" type="radio"/><label aria-disabled="true" for="navi">Na'vi</label></fieldset></article>
blocks.code:
<fieldset>
  <legend>Second language:</legend>
  <input type="radio" id="hindi" name="second-language" checked />
  <label htmlFor="hindi">Hindi</label>
  <input type="radio" id="swahili" name="second-language" />
  <label htmlFor="swahili">Swahili</label>
  <input type="radio" id="navi" name="second-language" disabled />
  <label htmlFor="navi" aria-disabled="true">Na'vi</label>
</fieldset>

blocks.label: Validation states example
blocks.demo: <article aria-label="Validation states example" class="component"><fieldset><label><input aria-invalid="false" name="validation-states" type="radio"/>Valid</label><label><input aria-invalid="true" name="validation-states" type="radio"/>Invalid</label></fieldset></article>
blocks.code:
<fieldset>
  <label>
    <input type="radio" name="validation-states" aria-invalid="false" />
    Valid
  </label>

  <label>
    <input type="radio" name="validation-states" aria-invalid="true" />
    Invalid
  </label>
</fieldset>
